description:
List team members

Lists the people who accepted an invitation to your account, with what each may view and edit, as the team page shows them. Open invitations are not part of it: use `list_team_invites` for those, and `list_live_chat_agents` for the live chat staff. The membership `id` is what `remove_team_member` takes. Read only, no paging. Only the account owner can call this; a team member gets 403.
name: list_team_members
title: List team members
